hook.note: The son had a speech ready about no longer being worthy, and he never got to the end of it. Two details do the work: the father saw him while he was still far off, which means he had been watching that road, and the father ran. short350: You have wanted a Father your whole life. Not a doctrine about Him. Not a distant power. A Father — His voice, His heart turned toward you.
Father's Heart Bible is the first Bible in print where you can see who is speaking. Our Father's words in BLUE. The Son's in RED. The Spirit's in PURPLE.

For a hundred and twenty-five years, red letters have shown the Son speaking. Our Father speaks more than three times as often — 125,457 words across 5,623 verses — and every one of them has been printed in the same black ink as the genealogies. More than one word in four of the Bible is a divine person speaking. The color marks ownership, not quotation: His words stay His on any lips that carry them faithfully, words He never spoke are never colored, and narration stays black.

A son spent everything and came home rehearsing a speech about no longer being worthy. He never finished it. His father saw him while he was still far off, and ran. Not a Father waiting at the end of your recovery, but one already running toward you.
That is what this Bible was made to do. Not to tell you about a Father who speaks, but to show you where He already has.

Say plainly what this is not. It is not a treatment program, not a step study, and not a replacement for a doctor, a counselor, a meeting, or a sponsor. Recovery is real work done with real people, and no book substitutes for it. This is a complete Bible, and the reason it exists in this edition is one sentence long: shame is loud, and it is easier to argue with when you can see, in His own color, exactly what our Father said.

It is also for the families. The people who have waited up, counted days, hoped and been disappointed and hoped again — the ones who read Luke 15 and find themselves in more than one character. The opening pages were written with them in the room.

He is not distant. He is not disappointed. He is your Heavenly Father, and He delights in you as His beloved child. If father is not a word of comfort for you, this Bible is especially for you: the Father revealed here is no projection of broken human fatherhood, but the original, from whom every family in heaven and on earth takes its name.

An introduction opens each book, a Father's note closes each with a short prayer, and 1,354 notes serve the reader, not the scholar. A presentation page carries their name. Six by nine, hardcover, full color throughout.
A fresh translation from the original Hebrew, Aramaic, and Greek — complete, 66 books and 31,085 verses. A gift, a keepsake, an heirloom.
Receive the Father. Hear His voice. His heart is for you.

Our Father's words in BLUE. The Son's words in RED. The Spirit's words in PURPLE.

It is the complete Father's Heart Bible™ — 66 books, 876 pages, the same translation carried in every edition. What is made for this reader is the cover and the pages that open the book. It is not a program, and it does not replace one.

long.h: You have carried this longer than anyone knows. Your Father is not waiting for you to clean up first.
body: A son took everything his father gave him and spent it all. What finally turned him was not shame — it was remembering what kind of father he had. He walked home rehearsing a speech about no longer being worthy. He never got to finish it. “While he was still far off, his father saw him, and his heart broke with compassion—he ran, threw his arms around him, and kissed him.” — Luke 15:20. “For this son of mine was dead and is alive again; he was lost and is found.” — Luke 15:24.
Your Father is not waiting at the end of your recovery. He is already running toward you. It is a devotional Bible for daily Bible reading and intimacy with God, so you hear Him for yourself.

Two details in that verse are worth the whole edition. The father saw him while he was still far off — which means he had been watching the road. And the father ran, before a word of the apology was spoken. Nothing in the story is conditional on the speech.

What this Bible gives you is our Father Himself — His voice on the page, His heart toward you plain enough to see in color. That is first, and it is the thing recovery is finally about: a Father who was watching the road. Recovery is also real work, usually with a doctor, a counselor, a meeting and a sponsor, and this does not replace any of them.
It also makes no claim about how your story goes. Relapse is not evidence that our Father changed His mind, and there is nothing in this edition that suggests otherwise.
What it does is checkable on any page: our Father's own words are set in BLUE and the Son's in RED, so when shame starts talking you can see exactly which words are His and which are not.

long.h: A three color Bible: red letter, blue letter, purple letter
body: For a hundred and twenty-five years, the red letter Bible has shown you the Son speaking. Our Father speaks more than three times as often — 125,457 words across 5,623 verses — and every one of them has been printed in the same black ink as the genealogies. He has been speaking the whole time. No Bible has ever shown you where.
Our Father's words in BLUE. The Son's words in RED. The Spirit's words in PURPLE. More than one word in four of this Bible is a divine person speaking.

The color is a mark of ownership, not of quotation. His words stay His on any lips that carry them faithfully, and words He never spoke are never colored. Narration stays black. You can see it for yourself before you buy anything: every word is free to read at fathersheartbible.com/read.

God is our Father. Not a role He plays. Father is who He is, and Father is His name, the name Jesus came to reveal: “I revealed your name to those you gave me from the world” (John 17:6). This translation lets the Hebrew and Greek speak the distinction they always made: God as Father, Abba Father, your Heavenly Father — and you, His beloved child.

Notice who, in Scripture, speaks of Him only as a distant deity and never as Father: the serpent in Eden, Pharaoh, the accusers in Job, the tempter in the wilderness. The enemy's strategy has not changed since the garden — to make the Father seem distant, demanding, and disappointed.

If the word father is not a word of comfort for you, this Bible is especially for you. The Father revealed here is no projection of broken human fatherhood. He is the original, from whom every family in heaven and on earth takes its name.

faq.q: What makes the Recovery Bible different from the other editions?
faq.a: It is the complete Father's Heart Bible™ in Divine Voice Color — the same translation, the same 876 pages, the same 1,354 study notes as every other edition. What is made for this reader is the cover and the pages that open the book: a word written for this reader, and passages on intimacy, identity, and inheritance chosen for where they are. We would rather tell you that plainly than claim notes or prayers that are not in it.

faq.q: Is this the whole Bible, or a selection?
faq.a: The whole Bible. 66 books, 1,189 chapters, 31,085 verses, Genesis to Revelation, nothing abridged — 876 pages of it, in full color throughout.

For a hundred and twenty-five years red letters have shown the Son speaking. Our Father speaks more than three times as often — 125,457 words across 5,623 verses — and until now those words were printed in the same black ink as the genealogies. In Divine Voice Color you see who is speaking: our Father's words in BLUE, the Son's in RED, the Spirit's in PURPLE. More than one word in four of the Bible is a divine person speaking. The color marks ownership, not quotation — His words stay His on any lips that carry them faithfully, and words He never spoke are never colored.

faq.q: Can I read it before I buy a copy?
faq.a: Yes, all of it. Every word of the Father's Heart Bible™ is free to read at fathersheartbible.com/read, in twenty-five languages, with the color on the page exactly as it is in print. English and Telugu can also be listened to. Nobody has to buy anything to receive our Father's voice.

faq.q: Is this a 12 Step Bible or a step study?
faq.a: It is the complete Bible, Genesis to Revelation, with our Father's own words in BLUE — and what recovery needs first is a Father who speaks and does not leave. The father in Luke 15 was watching the road. Programs and sponsors and meetings do real work, and this is not one of them; it is the voice underneath them, given to you whole.

faq.q: Is it for the person in recovery, or for the family?
faq.a: Both, honestly. The opening pages were written with the families in the room — the people who have waited up, counted days, and hoped again after being disappointed. Luke 15 has three people in it, and most families find themselves in more than one of them.

Our Father does not change His mind. The father in Luke 15 was watching the road while his son was still far off, and ran before the rehearsed speech could be spoken — that is His posture, and it is printed here in the Son's own words in RED. Relapse is real and it is hard work to come back from, with people who should be walking beside you. None of it moves Him.

faq.q: Is it a good gift for a treatment center, sober living house, or recovery ministry?
faq.a: Yes, and it is priced to be ordered together. Direct orders take 10% off at ten copies through 30% at 250, mixed freely across all sixteen editions, with free shipping at any quantity. For 500 or more, contact us directly. Every copy carries a presentation page for a name and a date.
